chunks: Al-ʿAbbās ibn Maʿrūf narrated from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Mihrān ibn Muḥammad, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: He instructed that mourning be held for him for seven seasons, and he endowed wealth for each season to be spent in it.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he gave an instruction or bequest
key_terms.فَأَوْقَفَ: then he endowed or set aside as waqf
key_terms.يُنَاحَ: mourning should be performed or lamentation held

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about allocating endowment funds for recurring mourning gatherings?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructed that mourning be observed for him over seven seasons and designated funds for each occasion. It reflects the establishment of a financial endowment for a commemorative religious purpose.
